A1.justification: Both PDFs describe EAGLE and contain readable main text, equations, five tables, and complete appendices. Relocated displays and renamed appendix captions can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v3 reports original attribution evaluations, hallucination-correction experiments, and ablations in Tables 1–5, with additional qualitative results in the appendix.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons, ablations, and appendix examples.

M1.justification: SLICO partitioning, the insight-plus-necessity objective, greedy search, saliency updates, and modality-influence calculation remain unchanged. Equations 1–5 and appendix Algorithm 1 retain the same procedures; deleting the optimality remark does not change the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MS COCO captioning and word localization, MMVP visual question answering, and RePOPE hallucination attribution. Appendix examples are retained; changing their description from object-level to word-level does not introduce a different task.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains LLaVA-CAM and IGOS++ (w/ GNC). Tables 2–3 retain these methods plus TAM. Newly added citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The same four model configurations, evaluation metrics, sensitive-token threshold of 0.2, and hallucination-correction procedures are reported. Appendix captioning and RePOPE prompts are unchanged, with no revised experimental settings identified.

E4.justification: Tables 4–5 retain the same objective-component ablation and subregion-count comparison using 36, 50, and 64 regions. The hallucination case studies and additional qualitative analyses in Appendix 9 are also retained.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 match, including EAGLE's Qwen2.5-VL 7B captioning insertion/deletion scores of 0.7006/0.4597. Qualitative results are retained. Adding the seconds unit to the existing 15.4 timing entry does not change its value.

T1.justification: v5 deletes v3's Remark 4, which asserts a reduction to monotone submodular maximization, a tight (1 - 1/e) greedy approximation, and essential optimality unless P = NP. This withdraws the stated approximation and optimality guarantee without replacement, although the mathematical definitions and complexity analysis remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about black-box token attribution, sufficiency and necessity, modality reliance, and superior faithfulness, localization, and hallucination diagnosis.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving sensitive tokens, language priors, object confusion, and occlusion remain unchanged. Appendix 8 retains the scalability and partial-mitigation limitations. Section 3.2's caution that the objective may not be strictly submodular was already present in v3.

D1.justification: v5 adds an explicit project-page link on the title page. The supplied PDFs do not establish what code or data is available there. Algorithm 1, prompts, and other implementation disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v5 adds citations to CamEdit, Disentangle to Fuse, and DeFacto, and removes the Edmonds reference associated with the deleted optimality remark. The substantive positioning against existing attribution methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Editorial changes include simplified affiliations, added acknowledgements, correction of 'Token poisons' to 'Token positions,' and consistent word-level terminology in the appendix. The main prose and section sequence are largely retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves before the abstract, Figure 2 is slightly rearranged and moves earlier, and Tables 1 and 3 are relocated. Figures 12–14 receive terminology corrections in their captions. Existing displays are preserved, with no new experimental figures or table structures.

improvement.justification: Removing Remark 4's unsupported optimality guarantee resolves its conflict with Section 3.2's admission that the objective may not be submodular. Terminology corrections and the project-page pointer provide smaller clarity and access benefits. The improvement is limited because no replacement theoretical guarantee, new validation, or substantial implementation detail is supplied.
